title: India went from 0 to 172GW in solar manufacturing
sources: PIB, Aug 2026 - India's Solar Growth Enters a New Era
News on Air, 25 Mar 2026 - India's solar module manufacturing capacity rises from 3 GW to 172 GW
IndianWeb2, Aug 2026 - India Emerges as Global Solar Manufacturing Hub with 172 GW Capacity
caption:
In 2014, India couldn't manufacture a single solar cell. Today, it makes more solar panels than almost anywhere else on Earth.

As of March 2026, India's solar module manufacturing capacity hit 172 GW - a 75x increase from just 2.3 GW in 2014. Solar cell manufacturing, the actual technology inside the panel, went from zero to 27 GW.

This didn't happen by accident - government incentive schemes made domestic manufacturing worth building. Every gigawatt of new capacity means new factories, new engineering roles, new supply chains inside India.

This isn't just a climate story. It's one of the biggest manufacturing build-outs in India's history and it's still accelerating.
